images.prompt: One single photorealistic professional editorial cookbook photograph, softly sunlit bright warm home kitchen, light oak surfaces and neutral ivory ceramics, realistic appetizing food textures and achievable home cooking. Clean premium natural-light photography consistent across the series. Landscape 3:2 with moderate close framing, not extreme macro. Keep the food and relevant action comfortably inside the CENTRAL SIXTY PERCENT of image width so the important subject remains visible in a square center crop. No text, logos, watermark, collage, illustration, graphic border or faces. The ONLY recipe ingredients are eggs, zucchini sliced into ROUND COINS, feta cheese in small pieces, a little extra virgin olive oil and a few tiny dried oregano flakes. NO flour, pastry, crust, breadcrumbs, milk, cream, Parmesan, mozzarella, tomato, onion, garlic, black pepper, other vegetables, meat, bread or invented garnish. No fresh parsley or basil sprigs, no herbs as decorative food props. Completed Italian OVEN-BAKED zucchini and feta frittata served on a simple ivory plate, one small round homemade frittata about 16 cm across and only 1.5 to 2 cm thick, not a tall cake. It has a lightly golden set egg surface with recognizable round green-skinned zucchini slices and small white feta pieces embedded in it, a few tiny dried oregano flecks in the egg. A single triangular wedge has been cut and moved slightly forward on the SAME plate so its moist but fully set yellow egg interior and zucchini/feta are visible. No pastry or bread base, no quiche crust. All the round frittata AND the cut wedge are centrally grouped and fully inside the square-safe composition with empty plate around them. No additional food, no sauce, no garnish or cutlery. Warm bright professional three-quarter overhead view.

review.notes: Esaminati originale e quadrato: frittata cotta e dorata con rondelle di zucchine, feta bianca a pezzetti e origano secco; fetta separata che mostra uovo completamente rappreso e interno con verdura/formaggio. Nessuna base di pasta, pane o guarnizione estranea. Piatto avorio e luce naturale coerenti. Il quadrato conserva superficie, fetta e interno, tagliando solo parti periferiche della forma tonda.

images.prompt: Edit this single professional cooking photograph while preserving the realistic bright soft window light, warm light-oak kitchen, dark nonstick skillet on the hob and the SAME lightly golden ROUND zucchini coins with green skin rims. Correct the scene to show ONLY zucchini sautéing with a LITTLE olive oil in the pan. REMOVE the wooden spatula ENTIRELY, including every white grain on it. REMOVE every food bowl, herb plant, salt container, cheese or other food from the background; leave a clean plain light-oak worktop and a soft neutral bright wall. A plain unlabelled olive oil bottle may remain on the far left because olive oil is the only other ingredient used at this stage, but no other ingredient props. Zucchini rounds must have natural pale green-yellow flesh, thin green circular skins and a few gentle broad golden sautéed patches, with just a light realistic oil sheen, no oil pool or deep frying. No white crystals, salt grains, black pepper, herb flakes, eggs, feta, garlic, flour, butter or other food anywhere in the image. Keep the pan securely on the hob with a clear recognizable pan rim and burner support, entire central cluster of zucchini clearly visible and meaningful in a square crop. Single photorealistic editorial cookbook preparation photo, no collage, text, graphics, logo, watermark or border.

review.notes: Esaminati originale corretto e ritaglio: sole rondelle di zucchine con buccia verde e superficie lievemente dorata nella padella antiaderente, con velo di olio; padella stabile sul fornello. Rimossi spatola con granelli bianchi e ciotola di ingredienti della prima candidata. Nessun uovo, feta o origano in padella prima della fase prevista. Quadrato conserva forma delle rondelle e metodo; luce naturale e texture realistiche.
